description: This Java interface defines a contract for contributing to search queries in the OpenMRS project. It allows setting and retrieving a final search predicate, typically used for filtering or refining search results.

classes.name: SearchQueryContributor
classes.description: A Java interface that allows setting and retrieving a final search predicate to customize search queries, often used for applying filters or constraints.

methods.name: setFinalPredicate
methods.description: Sets the final search predicate using a function that produces a SearchPredicate given a SearchPredicateFactory.

methods.name: getFinalPredicate
methods.description: Retrieves the current final search predicate function, if any.
